Additionally, Tilottama Sen and teammates won silver in shooting, contributing to India's overall count.

title: Asian Games: Prachi Choudhary wins 400m bronze as India’s medal tally swells to 30

This victory raised India's total medal count to 30, comprising four gold, 12 silver, and 14 bronze. Tajinderpal Singh Toor secured a silver in the men’s shot put after a strong competition. Meanwhile, two athletes advanced to the women’s 200m final, showing promise for further medal opportunities.

title: Housing sales slipped 6% in top Indian cities during Jul-Sep quarter: Report
description: In the July-September quarter, residential property sales in nine key Indian cities dipped by six percent, totaling just 1.03 lakh units, a stark contrast to last year's figures. This decline signifies lower demand alongside a decrease in new housing supply. While Bengaluru and Hyderabad saw slight growth in sales, many other cities faced significant drops, reflecting a broader slump in the residential real estate market amidst prevailing economic challenges.

title: Bengaluru man strangled wife, spent 3 days with body before dumping it
description: Sagar Chandra Ravath allegedly killed his wife Anusuya Behra during an argument and concealed her body. He wrapped the body in a bed and left it in their house for three days. title: Asian Games: Tajinderpal Singh misses hat-trick of golds, wins silver in shot put

After undergoing ACL surgery in 2019 and shifting her focus from long jump to pole vault, her success stands as a historic milestone for India. With heartfelt gratitude towards her parents and coach, Elangovan hopes to inspire the next generation of Indian pole vaulters.

title: US immigration authority has a 10-day deadline on home address
description: USCIS has issued a reminder for immigrants to report changes of address within 10 days of moving. Failing to do so may result in missed notices and delays in immigration cases. Changing addresses with the USPS does not automatically update records with USCIS. Immigrants are encouraged to use the online self-service change-of-address tool for a timely update. Paper forms can be submitted, but online updates are recommended for efficiency.

title: Watch: Stone pelting shatters Duronto window as passengers sit just inches away
description: A stone was thrown at the Duronto Express after it passed Borkhedi station in Maharashtra. Window glasses in coaches A-1, B-2, and B-5 were shattered due to the incident. Railway Protection Force and Government Railway Police conducted a thorough search in the surrounding areas. No evidence or suspicious persons were found after the investigation. A case was registered against an unknown person under the Railway Act.

title: Influencer flaunts gold, cash on Instagram; burglars make off with booty
description: After showcasing their opulent lifestyle on social media, businessman Vinoth Kumar and his influencer partner Madhumitha suffered a robbery, resulting in a loss of about Rs 1 crore in valuables. Police suspect the burglars used social media to pinpoint when the couple was away from home. Investigators are scrutinizing Madhumitha’s online content related to their shopping trips. To apprehend the thieves, five police teams have been deployed.

title: Masked men try to abduct woman in Dehradun; police form teams to nab them
description: Early in the morning, at 6:45 AM on Sahastradhara Road in Dehradun, an attempted abduction occurred involving two men in a black hatchback. As a woman was returning home after dropping her daughter at college, she became a target. Fortunately, local witnesses, including sanitation workers, stepped in to assist and notified authorities.

title: Girl started lemonade stand with $10 goal; 7 summers later, sisters raised $55,000
description: Grace Hendrian and her sister June initiated their Lemon-Aid Stand for Good in 2019 to support charity. They aimed to raise $10 but ultimately collected $55,000 for The Salvation Army. Their project encouraged community participation, leading to 14 stands operating by 2026. The sisters received recognition for their volunteer efforts as they also contributed to local families in need. Their fundraising initiative concluded in 2026, marking its final season.

title: 'Floods don’t travel with visas’: Nepal PM asks India, China to join warning network
description: In his maiden address to UN General Assembly, Shah, 36, said, “Glaciers and floods do not travel with a visa stamped on passports.” His address on Thursday came during his first foreign trip since taking office on March 27.

title: Manager with Rs 85 lakh package reveals how much he actually gets each month
description: Sidharth Maheshwari's insights shed light on the often misleading nature of CTC figures in the job market. For instance, an attractive salary of ₹85 lakh includes various elements such as fixed pay, bonuses, and variable compensation. However, after mandatory deductions like taxes and other non-cash perks, the actual take-home can drop considerably. Therefore, job seekers must be aware of these salary intricacies to ensure they make financially sound choices.

title: Brittany Mahomes earns major recognition as KC Current’s $375M rise continues #20
description: Earlier this year, the Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in the Northeast neighbourhood, aiming to give 120 children aged 8 to 10 access to the sport. Co-owner Brittany Mahomes supported the initiative. She also received United WE’s inaugural Champion for Change Award, recognising her leadership in women’s sports and community development, alongside the Mahomes family's philanthropic efforts through the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation.

title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.
